summary: Route standalone requirements to direct implementation; VDD create/repair requires explicit directory request; choose standard/resumable/self-hosted first, then hash-bound model routing; read three mandatory references and repository authority; clarify only material blockers; lifecycle: draft>plan-ready>implementation-authorized>implementation-complete>acceptance-passed>archived with distinct owners; each slice declares behavior, failure selector/intent, GREEN target, dependents, recovery; VDD never executes or emits RED evidence; terminal full validation is mandatory; repair in place under repair/round-N with immutable history and hash-bound closure; Bootstrap review optional, lineage budget two, hard limit three with typed trigger; repair requires generated callsite inventory, sibling dispositions, controlled composition receipt, and manifest-derived changed set; knowledge preflight is mandatory before source freeze and plan-ready; skill-input adapter, semantic-child launcher, and ready validator are mandatory before artifacts; Git baseline/current scope must be frozen and dirty state fully bound; review scope uses minimal complete closure; resumable/self-hosted require indexed append-only 95 report; completion requires artifacts, observable acceptance, failure path, stable targeted checks, and current full validation.
